title: Turkey with aubergine and tahini
summary: Turkey with aubergine and tahini is a middle eastern dinner built around turkey breast steaks and aubergines, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Turkey with aubergine and tahini into even pieces and toss aubergines with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of aubergines while you season turkey breast steaks. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle turkey breast steaks and tahini among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Turkey with aubergine and tahini before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Turkey with aubergine and tahini into warm bowls with the juices.
